thread:
Sam (CTO): Thanks everyone — quick follow-up thread for runtime roadmap Qs from today's all-hands. I'll drop answers and we can flag items that need docs or tickets.
Riley (Runtime): Can you clarify the timeline for the kernel work that targets long-sequence p99? Is that still H2? :eyes:
Sam (CTO): Yes, priority A is the long-seq kernels and mem-tiling optimizations. Targeting an internal canary in ~3 weeks, broader rollout in ~8 wks.
Kai (ML): For the record, the kernel changes require fused attention variants + 8-bit-friendly matmul paths. We'll need coordinated quantization tests.
Priya (Product): Will any of this change customer-visible model behavior (token-level output)? We need to prep messaging.
Riley (Runtime): Short answer: no functional changes expected. There is a small chance of distribution-level drift from FP16->INT8 QAT; we'll gate with eval sets.
Maya (Perf): Early microbench on the new kernel: seq=1024 p50 28ms -> 18ms, p99 140ms -> 85ms. Putting full numbers into the perf board.
Anna (Eng): Heads-up: the canary config needs a fallback policy if latency regresses — should we auto-fallback to the previous kernel variant?
Sam (CTO): Yes, auto-fallback to prev-variant for >=10% increase in p99 for 5m window. Ops team will own thresholds.
Jared (SRE): We'll add an alert rule; can someone post the canary traffic command?
Devon (SDK): Canary rollout script is `tools/canary_rollout.sh --variant vkernel2 --pct 10`. We should add a `--eval-check` flag.
Riley (Runtime): Good call. We'll add an automated eval that runs the core prompt-suite before promoting. If it fails, deploy-bot will abort.
deploy-bot: Canary started for vkernel2 on cluster-redwood-canary, 10% traffic.
Anna (Eng): I'm seeing a small regression on a rare decoding pattern (repeated stop tokens) on canary, attaching minimal repro: `input: "Tell me a story\n\nStop\nStop\n"`.
Kai (ML): Thanks — that looks like a KV index edge-case. I'll test a fix; if confirmed, we can patch the kernel or shim in the runtime to normalize KV offsets.
Priya (Product): Can we capture per-customer impact so sales/customer-success don't get surprised? Even if it's very rare.
Jared (SRE): We'll enable per-route sampling for 24h and export to the incident board.
Maya (Perf): I'll add a perf regression dashboard and link the canary artifact IDs.
Sam (CTO): Action items: Riley/Kai pair on KV edge-case (ticket), Riley/Anna add auto-fallback + eval gating (ticket), Maya to publish perf doc, Dev add `--eval-check` to canary script. I'll sync with product on messaging.
Riley (Runtime): Thanks — I'll create the PRs and post links here. :thumbsup:
Anna (Eng): FYI — tagging infra for GPU kernel rollout window (avoid major infra maintenance).
Devon (SDK): Also adding an SDK flag to toggle new kernels for debugging: `client.experimental.kernels = "vkernel2"`.
Sam (CTO): Great thread. If anything blocks the canary tomorrow, ping me directly.
Priya (Product): Thanks — will draft a short customer note in #customer-success once we confirm no behavior changes.
Riley (Runtime): Quick note: please don't merge any unrelated perf changes into canary branch until we stabilize kernel telemetry.
Sam (CTO): Noted. Closing the loop here — keep updates short in this thread. Appreciated!
